The No. 5 Indiana Hoosiers host the No. 4 Ohio State Buckeyes for a top-five Big Ten conference showdown at Memorial Stadium. Indiana sits in first place in Big Ten with Josh Hoover leading the team, while Julian Sayin leads third place Ohio State.

title: College Football
description:
Oklahoma State at Houston
The No. 20 Houston Cougars host No. 18 Oklahoma State Cowboys in Week 7. Both teams carry a win streak into this matchup. Conner Weigman leads Houston with 15 touchdowns, while Drew Mestemaker has compiled 1,575 passing yards for the Cowboys.

title: College Football
description:
Nebraska at Oregon
The Oregon Ducks host the Nebraska Cornhuskers in Week 7 at Autzen Stadium. The Oregon Ducks enter the game with a 3-2 overall record after a Big Ten play, while the Nebraska Cornhuskers visit Eugene protecting an 5-1 record this season.
